# AQ Acentor

> AQ Acentor is a Spanish real estate developer specializing in new construction residential properties across major cities.

AQ Acentor develops high-quality residential projects (obra nueva) throughout Spain, with a strong presence in Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Málaga, Sevilla, and Murcia. The company is part of Aquila Capital and focuses on creating modern apartment developments and townhouse communities.

## Featured Projects

- [AQ Urban Zenit - Fase II](https://aq-acentor.com/promocion/aq-urban-zenit-fase-ii): AQ Urban Zenit Phase II new construction project in Málaga
- [AQ Nobuh - Fase II](https://aq-acentor.com/promocion/aq-nobuh-fase-ii): AQ Nobuh Phase II residential development in Dos Hermanas, Sevilla
- [AQ The One](https://aq-acentor.com/promocion/aq-the-one): AQ The One new construction project in Burjassot, Valencia
- [AQ Lumiria](https://aq-acentor.com/promocion/aq-lumiria): AQ Lumiria residential development in Dos Hermanas, Sevilla
- [AQ Eyren](https://aq-acentor.com/promocion/aq-eyren): AQ Eyren new construction townhouses project in Murcia
